features_verified.lantern_out_event: Emitted when fuel reaches 0; remembers ever_lit = true
features_verified.lantern_refuel: Interacting with lit lantern consumes motes to replenish up to 100 fuel; +5 score per mote
features_verified.lantern_relight: Extinguished ever_lit lantern relights with only 5 motes; +40 relight score
features_verified.shade_drain_state: Wander shades target weak lanterns (fuel < 30), drain 5.0/s, emit fuel_drain every 60 ticks
features_verified.pulse_on_drain: Pulse hitting draining shade awards +15 points (vs +5 normal)
features_verified.win_condition_dawn_survived: Win at dawn (time_left <= 0) if lit lanterns >= ceil(0.6 * total); reason: dawn_survived
features_verified.loss_condition_dawn: Lose at dawn if lit lanterns < ceil(0.6 * total); reason: dawn
features_verified.loss_condition_no_flames: Immediate loss when flames reach 0; reason: no_flames
features_verified.scoring_system_v1_2: +5 per deposit mote, +100 first light, +40 relight, +5/+15 pulse, +50+floor(fuel) per lit lantern at dawn, +50*flames. Time bonus removed.
features_verified.colorblind_mode: Accessible color palette toggle: blue cyan shade aura/eyes, white danger alerts with warning icon ⚠, collapsed unlit lanterns, low fuel blinking.
features_verified.web_physics_fixes: Spacebar jump fix, jump pad trajectory launch, tiered mountain cliff wall boundary, pointer lock mouse look.
